s: The AP Cabinet on 10 November 2026 approved a 'Robotics and Physical AI Policy' for which period?
x: The Cabinet approved the AP Robotics and Physical AI Policy 2026–2036; 2026–31 is the AVGC-XR Policy and 2024–29 the Semiconductor and Display Fab Policy.

s:
Match the AP policies approved/amended by the Cabinet on 10 Nov 2026 with their periods:
A. AVGC-XR Policy   B. Robotics and Physical AI Policy   C. Semiconductor and Display Fab Policy (4.0)
1. 2024–29   2. 2026–31   3. 2026–2036
x: AVGC-XR Policy 2026–31; Robotics and Physical AI Policy 2026–2036; amendments to the Semiconductor and Display Fab Policy (4.0) 2024–29.

s: The new Directorate of Traffic Management and Road Safety approved by the AP Cabinet in November 2026 will be located at:
x: It is set up at Police Headquarters, Mangalagiri, headed by an IGP-rank officer.

s:
Consider the following about the AP Cabinet decisions of 10 Nov 2026:
1. APGENCO may explore Small Modular Reactor (SMR) nuclear technology as an alternative to thermal units.
2. A FLO Women Industrial Park was allotted 30 acres at Jayanthipuram, NTR district.
3. The Traffic Management and Road Safety Directorate will be headed by a DGP-rank officer.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The directorate is headed by an IGP-rank officer, so 3 is wrong; 1 and 2 are correct.

s: Who was appointed Chairperson of the Andhra Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (APERC) in November 2026?
x: Retired IAS officer Binoy Kumar succeeded P. Venkata Rama Reddy on 4 Nov 2026; Ancha Pandu Ranga Rao is Member (Legal).

s:
Consider the following about APERC:
1. It was set up on 31 March 1999 under the AP Electricity Reform Act, 1998.
2. It has a chairperson and two members.
3. Its chairperson holds office for five years or till the age of 65, whichever is earlier.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The term is five years or till age 70, whichever is earlier, so 3 is wrong.

s: In November 2026 P. Chandrasekhar was appointed to the AP Higher Education Fee Regulatory and Monitoring Committee (APHEFRMC) as the representative of:
o: All India Council for Technical Education
x: He was appointed as the National Medical Commission (NMC) representative for three years.

s: The AP Higher Education Fee Regulatory and Monitoring Committee functions under which law?
o: AP Higher Education Regulatory and Monitoring Commission Act, 2019
x: It was set up on 19 Aug 2019 under the AP Higher Education Regulatory and Monitoring Commission Act, 2019, to regulate fees of private unaided institutions.

s: 'Vidya Vahini', a digital learning portal launched in Andhra Pradesh on 11 November 2026, is an initiative of:
x: APSCHE launched Vidya Vahini under its LMS–MOOCs initiative on National Education Day, 11 Nov.

s:
Assertion (A): The Vidya Vahini portal was launched on 11 November 2026.
Reason (R): 11 November is observed as National Education Day, the birth anniversary of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad.
Choose the correct answer:
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
x: APSCHE chose National Education Day (Azad's birth anniversary, 11 Nov) to launch the portal.

s: Which of the following statements about APSCHE is NOT correct?
o: It was set up under the APSCHE Act, 1988 (Act 16 of 1988).
It was set up on the advice of the National Policy on Education, 1986.
It was created in 2014 after the bifurcation of Andhra Pradesh.
x: APSCHE dates from 1988 and is called India's first State Council of Higher Education; it was not created in 2014.

s:
With reference to municipal office-bearers in Andhra Pradesh, consider:
1. The Mayor of a Municipal Corporation is directly elected by voters.
2. The Deputy Mayor is elected indirectly by the members of the corporation.
3. Article 243R(2)(b) leaves the manner of electing a municipality's chairperson to the State Legislature.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Under AP's amended laws the Mayor and Chairperson are directly elected and the Deputy Mayor and Vice-Chairperson indirectly; Art. 243R(2)(b) leaves the method to State law.

s: 'Mana Mitra', praised by the Centre for its use in cyclone management in November 2026, is:
o: A mobile app for disaster warnings by APSDMA
A WhatsApp-based governance service of the AP Government
x: Mana Mitra is WhatsApp governance (95523 00009), launched by Nara Lokesh on 30 Jan 2025 at Undavalli.

s:
Match the AP e-governance initiatives with their year of launch:
A. D-Krishi   B. eHospital   C. e-Cabinet   D. Mana Mitra
1. 2017   2. 2022   3. 2024   4. 2025
x: D-Krishi 2017, eHospital 2022, e-Cabinet 2024, Mana Mitra 30 Jan 2025.

s: Which State ranked first in the Ease of Vehicle Ownership Index (EVOI) released in November 2026?
x: AP led the IndiaTech.org–Consumer VOICE index, followed by Kerala and Tamil Nadu; Delhi was 4th and UP last.

s: In the AP Health Department's patient-satisfaction assessment of PHCs for October 2026, which district stood first?
x: Palnadu was first (81.6%), Polavaram second (81.5%); Kurnool was last (69.5%).

s:
Consider the following about the drought declaration for Kharif 2026 in Andhra Pradesh:
1. 24 mandals in eight districts were declared drought-affected.
2. All 24 mandals were classified as severely affected.
3. Most of the severely affected mandals are in Kurnool district.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 12 mandals were severe and 12 moderate (G.O. 5), so 2 is wrong; Kurnool has six of the 12 severe mandals.

s: For Kharif 2026, which insurer was selected to implement PMFBY in nine districts of Andhra Pradesh, including Krishna, Kurnool and NTR?
x: TATA AIG General Insurance was selected for nine districts, implemented through the Agriculture and Cooperation Department.

s: Under PMFBY, what is the maximum premium paid by farmers for Rabi food and oilseed crops?
x: Farmers pay 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseed crops and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops.

s: In Swachh Survekshan 2025–26, which AP city was placed among the top three clean cities of the Super Swachh League along with Navi Mumbai and Surat?
x: Vijayawada was in the top three of the Super Swachh League; Visakhapatnam was top-three in the million-plus category.

s:
Consider the following about AP in Swachh Survekshan 2025–26:
1. Tirupati and Kuppam won as a 'Swachh Shehar Jodi', with Tirupati as the mentor city.
2. Visakhapatnam was among the top three in the million-plus population category.
3. It was the 5th edition of Swachh Survekshan.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Swachh Survekshan 2025–26 was the 10th edition (launched 2016), so 3 is wrong.

s: The National SARAS Mela 2026, the first held outside Delhi-NCR, was organised at:
x: It was held from 13–31 Oct 2026 at Punnami Ghat, Vijayawada, by the Ministry of Rural Development with SERP; AP topped sales with ₹2.99 crore.

s: Which of the following about the National SARAS Mela 2026 is NOT correct?
o: It was organised by the Union Ministry of Rural Development with SERP, AP.
Andhra Pradesh was first in sales with ₹2.99 crore.
Uttar Pradesh was second in sales.
It was the first SARAS Mela ever held, started in 2026.
x: The first National SARAS Mela was in 1999 in Delhi; the 2026 mela was only the first held outside Delhi-NCR.

s: By how much did Andhra Pradesh's Gross GST collections grow in October 2026 over October 2025?
x: Gross GST rose 24% to ₹4,307 crore (national 16%); 19% is Net GST and 21% SGST growth.

s:
Arrange the following States by Gross GST growth in October 2026, highest first:
1. Kerala  2. Andhra Pradesh  3. Karnataka  4. Tamil Nadu
x: AP 24%, Kerala 23%, Karnataka 18%, Tamil Nadu 3%.

s:
Consider the following about AP's GST data for October 2026:
1. Net GST collections were ₹3,582 crore, up 19%.
2. AP's Net GST growth was above the national average of 13%.
3. AP's Gross GST collections crossed ₹5,000 crore.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Gross GST was ₹4,307 crore; ₹5,329 crore is total Commercial Taxes, so 3 is wrong.

s: AP's cumulative Net GST collections for April–October 2026 were about:
x: ₹23,217 crore against ₹19,781 crore in the same period of 2025, a growth of 17.4%.

s: In the Access (In)Equality Index 2026, Andhra Pradesh ranked:
x: Goa was 1st (0.68), AP 2nd (0.66) and Sikkim 3rd; 13th is AP's rank in per capita income.

s: The Access (In)Equality Index is prepared by:
o: Centre for New Economic Studies, O.P. Jindal Global University
x: The AEI (first in 2021) is a composite index by CNES, O.P. Jindal Global University.

s:
Consider the following about the Access (In)Equality Index 2026:
1. It uses five equally weighted dimensions.
2. Andhra Pradesh ranked first in the socio-economic security dimension.
3. Andhra Pradesh was ranked first overall.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: AP was 2nd overall (Goa 1st), so 3 is wrong; it topped socio-economic security with 0.69.

s: According to the AP Socio-Economic Survey 2025-26, which district ranked second in fish production after Eluru?
x: Eluru (10,39,792 t) was first and Krishna (9,95,145 t) second, then West Godavari, Bapatla, Nellore.

s:
Arrange the districts by number of MSME units established in 2025-26 (AP Socio-Economic Survey 2025-26), highest first:
1. Palnadu  2. Visakhapatnam  3. Ananthapuramu  4. Guntur
x: Visakhapatnam 12,334, Palnadu 11,472, Ananthapuramu 10,155, Guntur 6,542.

s: Which district reported the largest number of drought-affected farmers (about 1.85 lakh) in Kharif 2026 in Rayalaseema?
x: Kurnool reported about 1.85 lakh affected farmers and damage over 1.68 lakh hectares.

s: Meteorological drought is said to occur when rainfall is below normal by:
x: Meteorological drought = rainfall 25% or more below normal.

s: The 31st CII Partnership Summit was held on 12–13 November 2026 at:
x: It was held at the Andhra University Engineering College grounds, Visakhapatnam, like the 30th edition in 2025.

s: What was the theme of the CII Partnership Summit 2026?
o: Building Bridges of Trust, Technology and Trade
Navigating New World Order: Trade, Technology, Trust
x: The 31st summit's theme was 'Navigating New World Order: Trade, Technology, Trust'.

s:
Consider the following about the CII Partnership Summit:
1. It has been held annually since 1995.
2. It is organised with DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
3. The 31st edition (2026) was the first held in Andhra Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The 30th edition (2025) was also in Visakhapatnam, so 3 is wrong.

s: According to PTI, how many MoUs were signed during the two-day 31st CII Partnership Summit (2026), and of what value?
x: 109 MoUs worth ₹9.02 lakh crore; 194 MoUs were at the regional conferences, 73 MoUs + 15 G.O.s on Day 1; 410/₹9.8 lakh crore was the 2025 pre-summit target.

s: At the CII Partnership Summit 2026, Reliance Industries committed about ₹2.73 lakh crore in which district?
x: Reliance's ₹2.73 lakh crore commitment, the largest on Day 1, is in East Godavari.

s:
Match the CII Summit 2026 investors with the district of their project:
A. Kia India   B. GAIL India   C. JSW Group   D. Megha Engineering (renewables)
1. Srikakulam   2. Kadapa   3. Sri Sathya Sai   4. Krishna
x: Kia – Penukonda (Sri Sathya Sai); GAIL – Srikakulam; JSW – Kadapa; MEIL – Krishna.

s: AM Intelligence Labs' 512 MW green integrated AI data centre approved by the AP Cabinet in November 2026 involves an investment of about:
x: The Cabinet approved ₹31,387 crore for the 512 MW AI data centre in Visakhapatnam district.

s:
Match the companies (AP Cabinet, 10 Nov 2026) with their project locations:
A. Carbon Cosmo Advanced Materials   B. Epack Data Centre Solutions   C. Reliance Industries (AI data centre)
1. Rambilli, Anakapalli   2. Naidupeta, Tirupati   3. Vizianagaram
x: Carbon Cosmo – cathode complex at Naidupeta; Epack – Rambilli; Reliance – about 25 acres in Vizianagaram for a giga-scale AIDC.

s: Hwasin Automotive India, which signed an MoU with AP in November 2026 to make components for Kia cars, will set up its unit in which district?
x: Hwasin's ₹850 crore unit is in Sri Sathya Sai district; Iyamant India's ₹250 crore unit is in Kurnool.

s: INCOIS, which signed a tripartite MoU with Vignan's University and Ananth Technologies in November 2026, functions under which Ministry and where is it headquartered?
x: INCOIS was set up in 1999 under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, with HQ in Hyderabad; the MoU will use PFZ advisories.

s: Essar Renewables' proposed 300 MW hybrid project in Andhra Pradesh (about ₹4,500 crore) has a power purchase agreement with:
x: Essar Renewables signed a PPA with NHPC Ltd for the solar–wind–BESS project.

s:
Match the renewable energy projects in AP with their developers:
A. Pinnapuram Integrated RE Project   B. Upper Sileru PSP   C. Gandikota PSP
1. APGENCO   2. Greenko   3. Adani Renewable Energy
x: Pinnapuram (1,680 MW, Kurnool) – Greenko; Upper Sileru (1,350 MW) – APGENCO; Gandikota (1,000 MW) – Adani Renewable Energy.

s: In November 2026 Japanese company JERA signed a preliminary five-year agreement to buy green ammonia from Kakinada from:
x: JERA agreed with AM Green to buy 70,000 tonnes of green ammonia a year from Kakinada.

s: Andhra Pradesh's first Japanese Industrial Township is at:
x: Sri City, near the AP–Tamil Nadu border, hosts AP's first Japanese Industrial Township; Japan plans a second cluster.

s:
Consider the following about WIPO:
1. Its Convention was signed at Stockholm in 1967.
2. It became a UN specialised agency in 1974.
3. India joined WIPO in 1995.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: India joined WIPO in 1975, so 3 is wrong; WIPO is headquartered in Geneva.

s: In November 2026 the AP CM ordered restoration of 789 defunct lift irrigation schemes. Which body is to monitor and maintain them?
x: The Jalaharathi Corporation is to maintain the 789 schemes (₹632.07 crore) through a dedicated division.

s:
Match the lift irrigation schemes of AP with their water source:
A. Guru Raghavendra LIS   B. Taraka Rama Teertha Sagaram   C. Chintalapudi LIS   D. HNSS
1. Godavari   2. Champavathi   3. Tungabhadra   4. Krishna
x: Guru Raghavendra – Tungabhadra; Taraka Rama Teertha Sagaram – Champavathi; Chintalapudi – Godavari; HNSS – Krishna (Srisailam).

s:
Consider the following about the Handri–Neeva Sujala Sravanthi (HNSS) project:
1. It lifts Krishna water from the Srisailam reservoir.
2. It originates at Malyala in Kurnool district.
3. It mainly serves the North Coastal Andhra region.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: HNSS serves drought-prone Rayalaseema (about 6 lakh acres), not North Coastal Andhra.

s: The Polavaram Irrigation Project was declared a National Project under which section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
x: Section 90 declares Polavaram a National Project; Sec. 84 = Apex Council, Sec. 85 = GRMB/KRMB, Sec. 89 = KWDT term.

s: One major objective of the Polavaram project is to transfer how much Godavari water to the Krishna basin?
x: Polavaram is meant to divert 80 TMC of Godavari water to the Krishna basin; 75.20 TMC is its live storage.
